messages:
amy_sales: Heads-up: BankCorp legal wants BYOK with HSM-backed KEKs, monthly rotation, no plaintext KEKs in Redwood. They also want cost delta for hosted. Need a concise FAQ + POC checklist to send today.

ravi_se: Confirming they expect envelope encryption where DEKs are wrapped by their KMS and Redwood never holds KEK material?

amy_sales: Correct. Preferred: AWS CloudHSM for primary, on-prem HSM for DR.

jordan_security: Security items to include: FIPS attestation level, HSM tamper/attestation reports, rotation audit trail, explanation that we store only encrypted DEKs and key metadata, and options for audit log export to their SIEM.

mike_eng: Implementation summary for the FAQ: 1) Flow: client generates per-object DEK -> wrap with customer CMK (aws kms encrypt or KMS GenerateDataKey) -> send wrapped DEK + ciphertext to Redwood. 2) Redwood stores wrapped DEK; unwraps by calling customer's KMS on-demand. 3) For on-prem HSM we support KMIP or a lightweight proxy with mTLS. 4) For perf, recommend short DEK cache TTL or async pre-wrapping; document security tradeoffs.

mike_eng: Small sample CLI snippet we can paste: `openssl rand -out dek.bin 32 && aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/ABC --plaintext fileb://dek.bin --ciphertext-blob fileb://dek.enc`

laura_pm: Pricing bullets for the FAQ: - Self-managed KMS: customer pays KMS/HSM charges; Redwood adds a per-proxy-operation surcharge. - Redwood-managed HSM/custom key store: adds fixed infra fee + hourly HSM and per-op costs. I'll draft numbers after infra ask.

ravi_se: Rotation note: customer rotates CMK; wrapped DEKs remain as-is. We will verify unwrap compatibility during POC and suggest a re-wrap job if customer requires all DEKs re-encrypted under new KEK.

jordan_security: Add sample audit record in FAQ: `{"event":"kms.decrypt","key_id":"arn:...","actor":"redwood-proxy","ts":"2026-02-10T15:04:12Z"}` and note retention/exports.

amy_sales: Can someone produce a 1-page FAQ + 10-step POC checklist (2-week timeline) by EOD? Need network checklist (PrivateLink/VPC peering or KMIP tunnel), required IAM policy for CMK, a contact list (KMS admin), and contract flags (no key escrow, breach notification).

mike_eng: I'll assemble the checklist and include an IAM snippet and minimal test vectors.

laura_pm: I'll assemble pricing and legal bullets and merge into the one-pager.

amy_sales: Great — thanks team, will send once you drop links. :pray:
